scope: Durable per-resource original archive intent, source preflight before authorization, exact-version recovery without a second COPY, legacy migration, and purge admission requiring non-legacy matching receipts.
validationBinding: Production code was unchanged after the 662-case related race run. The final integration-test file additionally covers an unjournaled pre-migration verifying upload; the supplemental isolated migration test passed. Deployment instructions were added after testing.
priorFailure: Initial unit smoke test failed because the cleanup-failure fixture had no staging bytes for the newly required preflight. Seeded those synthetic bytes; the targeted and related suites then passed.
verified: One winner among eight concurrent per-resource grants
Lease replacement and process reconstruction never repeat a consumed COPY
Lost COPY response recovers an exact archive version without staging; quota charged once
Read failure reuses the stored archive version; preflight failure does not consume an intent
Missing or denied archive observations never issue another write or complete backup
Late positive receipt survives lease expiry and logical trash, but cannot overwrite a different version
Foreign owner/resource, expiry, trash and database write failures do not create a grant
Migration marks both published and in-flight legacy resources, keeps existing backups readable, prevents duplicate COPY and refuses to invent quiescence
Purge admission requires each original resource to have a matching non-legacy receipt
